stability_equivalence: NOT REACHED: 0 wrfout produced (OOM before hour-1 output). No NaN/CFL was observed -- the run never advanced; failure is VRAM, not numerics.
recommendation: bigswiss is NOT a valid single-GPU benchmark target in fp64 on the RTX 5090. For the v0.17 headline pick a grid <= ~167k cols (e.g. 560x280 / 156,800 cols, the proven single-GPU 1km-unlock fits-ceiling) so a real warm wallclock + factor can be MEASURED; OR run bigswiss on multi-GPU (its real value per the project anchor is 1km-capability + cluster weak-scaling, not single-GPU speed); OR land the deferred MP-adapter + dycore-work column-tiling (v0.15 vram_ceiling_findings.json actionable path, ~4-5 GiB savings still short of the ~5+ GiB bigswiss overshoot).
